description: This file defines CLI commands for device pairing and token management, including listing, removing, clearing, approving, rejecting, rotating, and revoking device tokens, with fallback mechanisms to local device pairing functions.

methods.name: normalizeErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts an unknown error object to a string message.

methods.name: shouldUseLocalPairingFallback
methods.description: Determines if fallback to local device pairing should be used based on error and options.

methods.name: redactLocalPairedDevice
methods.description: Redacts sensitive info from a paired device object, summarizing tokens.

methods.name: listPairingWithFallback
methods.description: Lists device pairing info, with fallback to local device pairing if remote call fails.

methods.name: approvePairingWithFallback
methods.description: Approves device pairing, with fallback to local approval if remote call fails.

methods.name: parseDevicePairingList
methods.description: Parses raw data into structured device pairing list.

methods.name: selectLatestPendingRequest
methods.description: Selects the most recent pending device request.

methods.name: formatTokenSummary
methods.description: Formats device token summaries into a string.

methods.name: formatPendingRoles
methods.description: Formats roles for a pending device request.

methods.name: formatPendingScopes
methods.description: Formats scopes for a pending device request.

methods.name: resolveRequiredDeviceRole
methods.description: Resolves device ID and role from options, errors if missing.

methods.name: registerDevicesCli
methods.description: Registers CLI commands for device management including list, remove, clear, approve, reject, rotate, revoke.
